description: Three-phase voltage-source inverter (grid-following or grid-forming). Watch per-phase amplitude balance, voltage THD, and PLL/frequency stability.

pathologies.explanation: Per-phase amplitudes diverge by >5% — typical of broken phase reference, mismatched PI gains across abc/dq frames, or wiring/sign error on one leg.
Voltage THD on phase-a >8% — current loop bandwidth too low for grid harmonics, modulation saturating, or LCL resonance not damped.
Fundamental frequency falls well below 50/60Hz — PLL collapsed or droop loop gain mis-set; not a tuning-band fix.
Envelope (RMS proxy) oscillates around steady-state instead of staying flat — slow outer loop instability or weak-grid LCL resonance.
AC envelope never reaches target — modulator disabled, gating failure, or DC link not energised; implementation issue, not tuning.
First-swing overshoot well above tail RMS — voltage reference ramp too fast or current limiter set too loose; tighten ramp or add active current limiting.
